rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a specimen or a statistically selected subset.

example.english: We need to send this sample for testing.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 joeng6 bun2 jiu3 lo2 heoi3 faa3 jim6

rows.note: Use this for a physical product or material sample examined for its quality, colour, or design.

example.english: You can look at the colour of this sample first.
example.traditional: 你可以先睇吓呢塊樣辦嘅顏色。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 sin1 tai2 haa5 ni1 faai3 joeng6 baan6 ge3 ngaan4 sik1

rows.note: Use this for a small free food portion or package offered for tasting.

example.english: They’re handing out a sample pack at the supermarket entrance.
example.jyutping: ciu1 si5 mun4 hau2 paai3 gan2 si3 sik6 zong1
